_what: The facts about each live event, in one place. The page is checked against this, not the other way round.
_why: On 7 October 2026 the Public Speaking Drill moved to 13:00 Europe/Warsaw on Google Meet.
The page still said 09:00 CEST on Zoom in SIX places: the meta description, the
schema.org startDate and endDate, the eyebrow, the Date/Time/Where list, the length,
and the add-to-calendar link's UTC range. Three of those are machine readable, so a
search engine and anyone who clicked 'Add to Google Calendar' would have been told a
time nobody was going to be there.
Times are held in UTC because that is the only form with one meaning. The page says
CEST, which is correct until Europe falls back on 25 October and wrong after it, and
that is exactly the kind of thing a human gets right once and then forgets.

public-speaking.name: Human Intelligence: The Public Speaking Drill
